scope: Explicit per-layer canonical-null opt-in for newly authored AC1024 layers. Existing DRW_Interface subclasses and consumers that do not implement the separate provider keep their prior behavior.
contract: DRW_DwgCanonicalLayerProvider is a separate optional interface with a default-false method. The provider attests that each opted-in layer is newly authored and that its plot-style target has a complete output graph. The DWG writer requires the exact staged Global material target and non-null, distinct, consistent material and plot-style handles. It refuses retained DWG link evidence, non-null/invalid xref, extension dictionary, reactors, EED, app data, data-storage flags, pending source dependencies, conflicting aliases and versions other than AC1024.
behavior: The writer constructs a local layer copy with xdictionary-missing flag 1 and hard-pointer null xref. Caller-owned common state and xref fields remain unchanged. Rejected opt-in or allocation failure latches the current write as failed and preserves the destination. Explicit opt-in is required; it is the caller's responsibility not to request source-preservation changes for imported layers that lack retained DWG evidence.
validation: Nine focused material, layer, AC1027 graph and repeated-header tests passed. The layer test checks incompatible xref, retained source marker, conflicting plot alias and wrong-version refusal, caller state preservation, destination rollback and same-writer retry; lc3_compat_check compiled. GNU C++16 compiler with -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror syntax-checked the library facade and test.
independentPeer: An output authored through the provider is byte-identical to the previously independently qualified canonical control (SHA-256 318bd94261ac17630365800d165ac58b0fb0c037e249b6c2c927d82e6188f416). ODA File Converter 27.1 produced a DXF with no error file; its two layers retain the Global material and Normal placeholder references and dictionary/placeholder ownership. LibreDWG 0.14 independently decoded both layers with missing-xdictionary=1 and H5 null xref.
limits: The plot-style graph is an explicit caller attestation, not independently enforced by this provider. The selected peer conversion does not establish native rendering or plotting semantics, arbitrary layer profiles, AC1018/AC1021/AC1027/AC1032 authoring, physical-source HEADER suffix semantics, whole-document support, or phase-gate completion. All DWG/DXF controls are locally generated and uncommitted.
